tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje mus pa chen po'i dus chen skabs kyi tshogs chen gyi chos spyod sgrig rim bzhugs so// rje mus chen gyi dus chen hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gcig la dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dbu rtse snying ma'am lha khang chen po sogs su/ nged rang dpon slob/ mkhan chen/ las chen pa/ rgya mtsho dpon/ chos sde lho byang gi dge 'dun pa rnams dang bcas/ chos dung dkar po rgyang grags/ byung 'phral byon nas thog mar dkar cha bzhi nged rang gis bskul rjes dbu mdzad kyis bskul dgos/ bla mchod mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ /brgyud 'debs bar gzhung bsrang / brgyud 'debs rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma/ /rab mdzes ma sho lo ka gcig gi rjes su/ shes bya kun la ma/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma/ grags pas mkha' khyab ma/ dkon mchog gsum dngos yongs 'dzin sogs/ dkon mchog dges pa'i thugs ldan sogs/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma/ ngag dbang lha yi rjes bzung sogs sho lo ka re byas rjes/ gong bstod rnams bla mchod rgyun pa bzhin la/ tshangs dbang ma'i rjes su/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad nyer gcig tshangs spyod ma'i rjes su/ bsod nams dpag med zhes sogs tshigs bcad nyer gcig skabs 'dir mang ja dang po zhus nas/ ja mchod skal bzang ma mdzad/ de nas srid dral ma'i rjes su chos rnams ma nyer gcig chos rgyal ma'i rjes su shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i sogs nyer gcig sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje ma'i rjes su grags ldan ma nyer gcig de nas yon tan tshad med ma grub pa yan mdzad rjes byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs dang / 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs tshigs bcad gnyis song mtshams gung sangs mdzad/ de 'dus grub 'phral gsol ba gdan non zhu/ de nas sngags 'chang chen po'i bla ma rnams kyi sku bstod so la la rab mdzes ma/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma sogs bdag chen ngag pa'i sku bstod sho lo ka gcig

rigs gsum rnam 'phrul sogs bdag chen tshe nas kyi sku bstod sho lo ka gcig rgya chen bsod nams tshogs las sogs 'phags chen gyi sku bstod sho lo ka gsum/ dkon mchog gsum dngos sogs ngor chen gyi sku bstod sho lo ka gsum/ rgyal sras ngag gi dbang po sogs spyan snga rin po che'i sku bstod sho lo ka gcig de rjes byin rlabs char 'bebs ma gdangs ma/ shes bya kun la ma nyer gcig gdangs dang bcas pa/ de nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma gdangs ma/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma nyer gcig byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma gdangs ma/ skabs 'dir ja bar ma'i dang po te/ de steng dge 'dun pa rnams gsol ba mdzad pa'i ja mchod ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs ma mdzad/ de nas legs pa'i 'byung gnas gdangs ma/ grags pas mkha' khyab ma nyer gcig sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma gdangs ma/ gong bzhugs sku mched kyi sku bstod/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma nyer gcig rgyal ba gnyis pa gdangs ma/ spyan snga rin po che dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku bstod/ 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma gdangs ma/ gzhan tshig bcad thor bu ba rnams dkyus bzhin dang / gung sangs bla mchod skabs ltar mdzad/ skabs 'dir gsol chung gnang nas tshogs 'dus 'phral/ ji snyed su dag ma bskul ba'i sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang / zhes sogs la rol mo byas rjes/ mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /nas bskul mtshams byas pa'i bzang spyod tshar gcig gi rjes/ dpon slob thams cad bzhengs nas rten la phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas/ thog ma med nas da lta'i bar zhes sogs tshig bcad gcig po lnga brgya mdzad pa'i phyed dang gsum brgya song ba'i mtshams su/ lus kyi las ni sogs dang / 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs dang / mtshams med lnga po sho lo ka re re mdzad rjes dpon slob rnams gral la bzhugs nas/ bdag gi dus gsum ma brgya rtsa mdzad/

yang gong ltar bzang spyod tshar gcig skabs 'dir mang ja bar ma zhus nas ja mchod oṃ las ma mdzad/ de nas nged rang gi grogs mchog dam pa rab 'byams smra ba byams pa bsod nams 'od zer gyi don du bsngo ba rgyas par mdzad/ de nas thog ma med nas sogs kyi tshig bcad gong gi 'phros ma rdzogs bar byed/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs tshigs bcad thor bu rnams dang / bdag gis dus gsum ma brgya rtsa mdzad/ yang gong ltar bzang spyod gcig gi rjes su sangs rgyas sku gsum ma/ ston pa 'jig rten sogs sho lo ka gcig po song mtshams gung sangs mdzad/ 'dus 'phral bdag gi dus gsum ma brgya rtsa mdzad rjes bzang spyod tshar gcig dang / bdag gis dus gsum ma tshig bcad gsum mdzad/ de rjes bla mchod mchod pa nas brtsams bkra shis kyi bar bla mchod dkyus bzhin la/ maṇ+ḍal rjes su mang ja gsum pa'i dang po zhus nas ja mchod he ru ka dpal ma mdzad/ gsang chen ma grub mtshams smon lam tshig bcad thor bu rnams dang / bkra shis 'gro ba ma sogs kyi rjes su gung sangs mdzad/ 'dus 'phral mang ja gsum gyi gnyis pa sdom nas zhus/ zhal dkar 'then/ de nas bzang spyod/ mi mjed ma/ byams smon rnams dang / 'gro la bde skyid ma gdangs mdzad cing / mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi mthar brtan rgyas par mdzad do/ /ka l+ya na wadhan+tu/ nyi shu la gsol gong du cho ga tshar gcig dang / cho ga gting ma'i bum bskyed yan mdzad/ cho ga grol nas bla mchod yongs rdzogs dang / cho ga'i 'phros rnams mdzad pa dge/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rje mus pa chen po'i dus chen skabs kyi tshogs chen gyi chos spyod sgrig rim/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
